title: Europa RP 2026: A New Beginning
desc: As the year comes to an end, the world slows down under the quiet glow of winter lights. A moment when the old naturally gives way to the new.
body: >As the year comes to an end, the world slows down under the quiet glow of winter lights, allowing us to see more than usual. In moments like these, it becomes especially clear that nothing happens by chance: every decision, every step, every presence becomes part of a greater flow.
>Europa Roleplay is a space where stories weave into a single pattern, where attention brings reality to life, and a chosen role begins to respond in return.

>The New Year is not just a change of numbers — it is a gentle reboot. A moment when the old naturally gives way to the new, and accumulated experience becomes the foundation of the next cycle. We enter it with renewed energy ⚡, a more refined atmosphere 🌫️, a stable core ⚓, and even deeper interaction 🎭.
>The world will feel brighter and more precise, and coincidences — strikingly timely, as if everything has long been arranged, revealing itself only to those ready to see.

>Christmas light does not argue with the darkness and needs no explanation — it simply fills the space with warmth 🕯️, reminding us of calm, inner balance ☯, and the simple things that truly matter. May the new year bring you clear paths 🛤️, conscious choices 🧠, and people beside you with whom even silence feels right.<div class=
>
>Thank you for remaining a part of Europa Roleplay, for creating this world and filling it with meaning.<h3 class=
>Happy New Year & Merry Christmas 🎄
>EUROPA ROLEPLAY
>Reality is written by those who play.

title: Presidential Elections 2026
desc: A new era begins! Cast your vote or run for office to become the first President of Europa RP.
body: >We are thrilled to announce the start of the first Presidential Elections in our new era. This is your chance to lead the community and shape the political landscape of Europa RP.<div class=
>
>📅 Election Schedule:<ul class=
>May 13: Candidate Registration (via Support)May 14: Campaigning & AdvertisingMay 15: Official Voting at City Hall
>To run for President, you must be Level 10+, have a clean record, and pay the $100 Gold entry fee. Voting is open to all Verified players Level 2 and above.
>Results will be announced on May 15th at 19:00 server time.

title: Anti-Corruption: Real Estate Rules
desc: Ensuring a fair housing market: Administrators are now prohibited from occupying houses that players wish to purchase.
body: >To maintain a fair environment for our player base, the management has established a strict anti-corruption rule regarding real estate ownership.<div class=
>
>Administrators are prohibited from occupying houses that players wish to purchase.

>If you find an admin occupying a property you wish to buy, you have the official right to file a complaint. Valid complaints will result in the house being freed for player purchase immediately. Admins are here to support you, not compete for property!

title: Language Roles Implemented
desc: Enhancing communication across our global community with new dedicated language channels and roles.
body: >Following the recent community vote, we have officially implemented Language Roles to help reduce conflicts and improve communication within our Discord.

>Players can now select roles for languages including Arabic, Hindi, Turkish, Indonesian, Ukrainian, German, and more. You will be able to read all chats but write specifically in your designated language channel.
>Note: You can update your language role every 30 days. React in the Discord server to claim yours!

title: Rules & Leadership Update
desc: New staff appointments and updated server regulations regarding violations and punishments.
body: >The server environment continues to evolve. We've updated our rulebook to better suit the post-reset gameplay, including changes to C-Bug regulations and punishment severity.<ul class=

>Director: Congratulations to Farawla Fruity on the promotion.Chief Administrator: Welcome HaDy ZonKa to the team.Rule Change: Manual Slow C-Bug is no longer prohibited.Punishments: Many penalties have been decreased to better fit current playstyles.
>Please review the full rules in Discord to stay compliant.
